services.label: Silver Peak Services
services.title: Residential Design-Build Services for Major Projects.
services.text: Whole-house renovations, builds and rebuilds, and major additions come first, followed by ADUs, DADUs, and basement remodels. We also take select kitchen, bathroom, exterior, porch, restoration, carpentry, and tile projects.

part2.label: What We Build
part2.heading: From whole-house projects to focused work.

part1.label: Silver Peak Service
part1.text: Whole-house renovations, builds, and rebuilds involving structural work or coordinated changes across the property.

part2.label: Silver Peak Service
part2.text: Major additions planned around structure, access, permits, budget, and how new space connects to the existing home.

part3.label: Silver Peak Service
part3.text: Attached and detached dwelling units planned around access, utilities, zoning, privacy, and project feasibility.

part4.label: Silver Peak Service
part4.text: Basement remodels that add living space, bedrooms, storage, or room for a home office.

part5.label: Silver Peak Service
part5.text: Kitchens planned around workflow, storage, lighting, appliance placement, cabinetry, and natural light.

part6.label: Silver Peak Service
part6.text: Bathrooms planned for comfort, waterproofing, storage, accessibility, durable tile, and everyday use.

part7.label: Silver Peak Service
part7.text: Exterior updates that protect the home from weather, improve curb appeal, and repair siding, trim, and transitions.

part8.label: Silver Peak Service
part8.text: Covered porch and entry work that improves access, weather protection, and the home’s first impression.

part9.label: Silver Peak Service
part9.text: Rot, water, and structural damage repaired with careful assessment, thoughtful planning, and clean rebuild work.

part10.label: Silver Peak Service
part10.text: Built-ins, shelving, trim, natural wood details, tile, and custom finish work.

part1.label: North Seattle Design-Build
part1.heading: Planning first. Build with clarity.
part1.text1: Good remodeling starts before construction. Silver Peak reviews layout, materials, access, utilities, permitting needs, and existing site conditions so the project direction is realistic from the start.
part1.text2: Early review helps surface site and permit constraints before design decisions are settled.

part2.label: Project Priorities
part2.heading: Big Projects First. Detail at Every Scale.
